name: Arizona
dueDateNotes: Arizona follows the federal schedule: April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15.
selfEmploymentNotes: Arizona starts from your federal AGI and matches the federal standard deduction ($16,100 single / $32,200 married for 2026), then applies a flat 2.5% rate.
uniqueFacts: Arizona has one of the lowest flat income tax rates in the country at 2.5%.
Arizona's standard deduction matches the federal amount, so most filers subtract $16,100 (single) or $32,200 (married) before the 2.5% rate.
Arizona requires estimated payments once you expect to owe more than $1,000 in state tax.
